paragraphs: Your local, firefighter-owned team. South Louisiana roots. Personal service.
Springfield, Louisiana · Livingston Parish

From Carter Plantation to the Tickfaw and Blood River areas, give your lawn a plan for every season. Grow Green combines liquid fertilization, weed prevention, and targeted weed control with treatment photos, helpful service notes, and a local team you can reach.
Free estimate · Seasonal planned visits · No long-term contract
Your year-round lawn program

Your lawn’s grass type, treatable area, and trouble spots shape the estimate. We adjust nutrition and weed control through the year and document the work. Review the recommended care and monthly price before you approve service.
Monthly billing covers the year-round lawn program; it does not mean monthly treatments. Service is month-to-month with no long-term contract.
Tell us where the lawn is and what you’d like help with.
We explain the recommended care and arrange a start date after you approve.
Receive treatment photos, service notes, and directions for caring for your lawn afterward.
Free, no-obligation estimate

An open Carter Plantation lawn and a shaded yard near the river can have different conditions. We review the grass, sunlight, moisture, and problem areas before selecting care.
Our liquid program pairs seasonal nutrition with weed prevention and targeted control. Products and timing are selected for the grass, active problems, and application conditions.
We review the lawn’s response and address seasonal insect and disease needs according to the program and conditions. Visit photos and notes explain the work, aftercare, and any recommended follow-up.
We look at the weed species, the grass around it, and growing conditions before choosing treatment. Some weeds need continued management or a separate specialty plan.
Seasonal prevention helps limit new weeds. Existing grassy weeds are evaluated for targeted care based on the species, grass type, and growing conditions.
We identify the active weeds before selecting treatment. Problems such as Virginia buttonweed, dollarweed, and nutsedge can need continued attention as conditions change.
Ask about a separate specialty plan. We review the lawn and explain the scope, price, and timing before you approve.
What we apply, and when
Springfield lawns can move from rain-soaked ground to summer heat and dry spells. We adjust the visit to the lawn’s condition and season, including when weather calls for a change in timing.
Time feeding to active growth, address early weeds, and use preventive treatments at appropriate seasonal windows.
Adjust nutrition and weed control for heat, moisture, and turf response while monitoring seasonal insect activity.
Shift nutrition as growth slows, manage cool-season weed pressure, and watch for seasonal disease concerns.
Monitor lawn conditions and winter weeds. Dormant warm-season grass does not need the same nitrogen feeding as actively growing summer turf.
This is an overview of seasonal priorities. Actual products, rates, and visit timing depend on turf needs, weather, and label directions.
Know the grass. Match the care.
Centipede, St. Augustine, bermuda, and zoysia need different care. We consider sunlight, moisture, and mowing along with the grass type when choosing nutrition and weed-control treatments.
Learn why grass type matters: UF/IFAS guidance on centipedegrass and its lower fertilizer needs .
Firefighter-owned. Personally invested.

Grow Green is a firefighter-owned company based in St. Amant, serving Springfield and surrounding South Louisiana communities. Owner Dereck and the team back each lawn program with service photos, visit notes, and a local office.

See a weed issue between visits? Contact our office so we can review it. We check what your active lawn program covers and explain the next step. We explain any separate specialty treatment and its price before you approve.

What to expect from treatment visits, monthly billing, service calls, and getting your property ready.

    What to expect from treatment visits, monthly billing, service calls, and getting your property ready.

    Talk with our team
    How often do you treat lawns in Springfield?

    Our annual lawn program includes seasonal planned visits, generally about six weeks apart. Timing and applications depend on the season, weather, and turf condition. Each visit serves a purpose; eight visits do not mean eight identical fertilizer applications.

    How is lawn treatment priced and billed?

    Your estimate is based on the measured treatable lawn area, property conditions, and selected services. The annual year-round lawn program price is divided into twelve monthly payments. Monthly billing does not mean a treatment every month.

    Is there a long-term contract?

    No. Service is month-to-month with no long-term contract. Your estimate explains the recommended service, price, and terms before you approve.

    Do you serve Carter Plantation and the nearby river areas?

    Yes. We take requests for Carter Plantation, Springfield town center, the Tickfaw and Blood River areas, Shelter Cove, the Highway 22 corridor, and nearby Killian and Maurepas. Share your mailing address and ZIP code so we can confirm coverage and scheduling for your property.

    What if weeds show up between visits?

    Contact our office so we can review the concern and your active program. Our team checks what your active program covers and explains the next step. Any separate specialty treatment is explained and priced before you approve.

    How soon will I see results?

    Response varies with the weed species, grass, temperature, rainfall, and condition of the lawn. Some weeds begin responding after treatment, while persistent problems can need repeated or specialized care. We explain what to watch for in your service notes; lawn density also depends on consistent care and appropriate maintenance.

    Does lawn treatment include dallisgrass control?

    Dallisgrass is evaluated for a separate specialty plan. Choose the dallisgrass option on the quote form and tell us where it is growing. We explain the recommended scope, timing, and price before you approve.

    Can you help with large patch or a lawn that stays wet?

    We review the grass, symptoms, moisture, and growing conditions before recommending care. Seasonal disease treatments depend on your lawn program and the issue. Any additional treatment is explained and priced before approval. Persistent drainage problems also need attention; fungicide does not correct standing water or restore dead grass.

    Do I need to be home, and how should I prepare?

    Usually not, as long as we can access the scheduled treatment area. Unlock gates, secure pets, and share any access restrictions or sensitive areas. We provide service notes and product-specific directions for watering, mowing, and other aftercare.

    When can children and pets return to the lawn?

    Keep people and pets away from the treatment area during application. Follow the specific re-entry directions provided for the products used. A single waiting period does not apply to every treatment.

    Can you treat flower beds and rock beds in Carter Plantation?

    Yes. Ask about separate weed control for flower beds and suitable rock areas, and tell us about the plants and surfaces involved. We confirm the areas we can treat and provide separate pricing. You can also request fire ant service, tree and shrub care, core or liquid aeration, and help with lawn insect concerns.
